purpose: Test whether the MiMo-DeepSeek behavioral propagation boundary changes under the same mildly stochastic decoding temperature while retaining independent sham calibration.
taskSource: Reuse the same 32 task hashes and balanced recommender allocation as the matched temperature-0 pilot.
recommenderAllocation: Reuse the exact temperature-0 task-to-recommender-and-seed assignment.
shamSemantics: held-sham-a and held-sham-b receive identical semantic held-exposure states through independent calls and cache scopes at temperature 0.3.

generation.privacy: Send pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived constraint, utility, rank, and novelty features only.

primaryEstimands.adjustedPersistentFeedback: persistent feedback in immediate-versus-held minus persistent feedback in held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b
primaryEstimands.adjustedTraceDivergence: trace divergence in immediate-versus-held minus trace divergence in held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b
primaryEstimands.temperatureChange: temperature-0.3 adjusted effect minus the already frozen temperature-0 adjusted effect within provider

decisionRules.decodingSensitive: MiMo adjusted trace divergence becomes positive at temperature 0.3 while its sham-adjusted rate remains positive and the DeepSeek direction does not reverse.
decisionRules.providerContingent: MiMo adjusted trace divergence remains zero or non-positive while DeepSeek remains positive after sham adjustment.
decisionRules.stochasticityDominated: held-sham trace divergence equals or exceeds a positive exposure trace-divergence rate, or sham persistent feedback exceeds 0.05, in either provider.
decisionRules.noGo: valid action rate falls below 0.95, timeout rate reaches 0.05, or privacy validation fails.

claimBoundary: This 32-task mechanism pilot can discriminate decoding sensitivity from the observed provider boundary; it cannot estimate a production or population effect.
